source: Heyuan Intelligence Technology, DZ81-MA3UI5C Modbus register list (xlsx from the manufacturer download page)
notes: Modbus RTU on RS-485, 1200 to 19200 baud; the register list gives defaults of address 1 and serial code 3 (9600 baud, parity N, 8 data bits, 1 stop bit).

Measured values, the settings and the energy zone are read with function 03 or 04 (holding registers are used here), settings are written with function 06 or 16, the clock with function 16 only; the relays are coils (function 05 / 01) and the digital inputs use function 02. Addresses are the decimal addresses of the list, address base 0.

Scales come from the list and its formula sheet: voltage Rx / 100 x PT, current Rx / 1000 x CT, power Rx x PT x CT (the table also calls it magnifying 1000, which is the same in kW), power factor Rx / 100, frequency Rx / 100, unbalance Rx / 10000 x 100 %, harmonic content and THD Rx / 1000 x 100 %. The scale here gives the secondary-side value; multiply by PT and CT as noted in the descriptions for the primary value.

Energy values are 32-bit in 0.1 steps; the list does not state the word order, so high word first is assumed. Tariff-period and previous-period energies are included as listed; the list gives no unit for the period totals ("Total Energy"), so none is set on those.
Registers named reserved or spare in the list are left out.
Written from the manufacturer's register list; not tested on a device.
description: Three-phase multifunction power meter with four-quadrant energy and tariffs: voltages, currents, powers, power factors, frequency, unbalance, harmonics up to the 31st, energies by period, configuration, clock, digital inputs and relays
